messages:
Clare R: quick question — infra CI flaked on prod: ArgoCD isn't picking up k8s manifests after an Atlantis apply. Anyone seen ordering/race issues between GH Actions -> Atlantis -> ArgoCD webhooks?
Samuel K: saw this last week. What did the GH Action run and what did Atlantis report? link to run: https://github.com/redwood-inference/actions/runs/12345
Clare R: infra-ci workflow ran `atlantis apply` after merge. Atlantis logs show success (exit 0). ArgoCD app ended up `OutOfSync`. Webhook delivery: first attempt 409, second 200 but ArgoCD says `no changes detected`.
Mike H: 409 usually means a concurrent update/conflict on the app. Any `kubectl` steps in the pipeline or force writes to the repo?
Clare R: no kubectl. Terraform + atlantis only. Manifests are in infra/apps/ generated in repo. ArgoCD is set to auto-sync on webhook. atlantis.yaml uses default handler for dir: infra/apps.
Nisha: possible git mirror lag — webhook can hit ArgoCD before the git server/mirror has the new revision. We fixed similar by adding a short backoff in the webhook handler elsewhere.
Samuel K: also check merge method and mirror delays. If GH does a squash/merge the ref resolution can be transient. Do we have the webhook payload id/times?
Clare R: payload id: 01H7ABCXYZ, timestamp: 2024-06-19T19:20:34Z. Delivery 1 -> 409 @19:20:35, Delivery 2 -> 200 @19:20:36 but logs: `no changes detected` even though files changed.
Mike H: argocd-repo-server logs: `time="19:20:36" level=info msg="scanning repo revision=refs/heads/main" error="rev not found"` — first scan couldn't resolve rev. Next scan found it, but then reported no diffs. That matches a race between push visibility and webhook.
Clare R: looking for actionable fixes. Thoughts: 1) add small retry/backoff on the step that triggers the ArgoCD webhook after atlantis apply, 2) ensure Atlantis marks commit status only after push is visible, 3) consider shortening ArgoCD poll interval for infra repos.
Samuel K: pragmatic: add a post-apply step that sleeps 2-3s then triggers ArgoCD refresh via webhook or `argocd app refresh`. Ugly but works.
Nisha: alternative is adjusting ArgoCD server timeouts or repo-server polling, but pipeline retry is lower blast radius. Also check GH Actions runner concurrency — parallel matrix jobs may interleave pushes.
Mike H: if infra-ci uses matrix jobs per region, they can race. Use `concurrency` in the workflow or serialize the push job with `needs:` so only one job updates infra/apps.
Clare R: I'll add `concurrency: group: infra-ci-apps` to serialize, and add a `sleep 3` after atlantis apply then call the webhook. Will test in staging.
Samuel K: also consider using `workflow_run` or a dedicated job that runs only once for the repo-push step. 
Mike H: add a line to the infra runbook: if ArgoCD shows OutOfSync after apply, check webhook deliveries, repo-server logs, and mirror latency; manual fix: `argocd app sync <app> --prune` or `argocd app refresh <app>`.
Clare R: will open a tiny PR to update .github/workflows/infra-ci.yaml and atlantis post-step, and will paste the PR link here when ready :thumbsup:
devops-bot: deploy checklist template updated: https://go.redwood/infra/runbooks/argocd-webhook-race
Clare R: leaving notes in the PR about concurrency + sleep and why. CC infra for review.
